ALPHA-01.note: 20-day cross-sectional momentum; no useful activation at declared thresholds.

SHORT-WAVE-03-RANK01.note: Direct rank implementation. RANK02/RANK03 not completed -- not misrepresented as tested.

DISCOVERY-01-RISK-01.note: Single-feature OOS classifier-score direct-rank low-volatility anomaly implementation.

shared_campaign_registry.population_semantics: Both candidate drivers import CAMPAIGN_REGISTRY_DB/CAMPAIGN_REAL_EXPERIMENT_ID/CAMPAIGN_PLACEBO_EXPERIMENT_ID directly from campaign_identity.py -- neither driver may redeclare its own copy of these values. The judge population for the campaign's REAL experiment_id is therefore always the union of every campaign_order candidate that has actually registered real trials (see wave06_campaign/run_campaign_judge.py), never one candidate's family alone. A candidate that has registered only SOME of its own frozen hypothesis ids (partial family attempt) fails the judge closed rather than being silently included or excluded. Retrying an already-registered candidate never creates a second registered candidate or changes this population -- only a new attempt of the same one. A placebo hypothesis can never enter the real population -- it is registered under the structurally distinct placebo experiment_id in the same shared registry.

campaign_order_guard.policy: LIQ-01 (order_position=1) is the only candidate eligible to execute at campaign start. Any later candidate is refused execution unless every earlier campaign_order candidate has a registry-VERIFIED closeout status artifact (CANDIDATE_CLOSEOUT_STATUS.json, written only by campaign_order_guard.write_closeout_status) whose verdict is in {REJECTED_NOT_ADVANCED, INCONCLUSIVE}. A missing, malformed, crashed, or incomplete prior attempt never authorizes the next candidate -- absence of a verified closeout is refused, not treated as an implicit pass. A closeout verdict of DEVELOPMENT_PROMISING_REQUIRES_FRESH_POINT_IN_TIME_CONFIRMATION permanently refuses every later candidate (the campaign has stopped). Order is never inferred from filesystem directory existence -- every closeout claim is cross-checked against real registered/succeeded trials in the shared registry before it is trusted.

advancement_policy.authoritative_threshold_source_note: Inspected before writing this policy: mqk_research.ml.multiple_testing_judge's own module docstring states this judge 'does NOT invent a promotion threshold'; dsr_pbo_sensitivity_cli.py, genuine_shuffled_placebo_cli.py, and p7a_p7b_economic_replay_stress_cli.py all compute/report values (dsr, pbo, passed) without asserting a caller-independent accept/reject bar. No authoritative numeric development-stage acceptance threshold exists anywhere in the committed repo. Every numeric threshold below is therefore a NEW, fixed, conservative, pre-outcome development-stage threshold chosen now with documented rationale -- never derived from or reactive to any Wave06 result (none exists at predeclaration time). Where a metric already has its own literature-standard natural decision boundary (DSR, PBO), that natural boundary is reused rather than inventing a new number.

primary_candidate_direction_control_rela.definition: For each family, the LONG_SHORT trial (rank_long_short) is the PRIMARY development candidate; LONG_ONLY (rank_long_only) is its CONTROL, isolating whether any edge survives without the short leg. The matched causal-placebo trial (same seed/turnover profile, shuffled labels) is the NEGATIVE CONTROL for the primary candidate.

absolute_economic_requirement.requirement: no RuntimeError gross-wealth-insolvency failure in either the long_only or long_short real attempt

benchmark_relative_requirement.rationale: Any candidate that fails to strictly exceed a naive dynamic equal-weight causally-rankable benchmark net of realistic costs provides no basis for further development investment -- the loosest defensible bar, not one tuned to an observed result.

matched_diagnostic_placebo_requirement.rationale: 0.20 Sharpe units is a fixed pre-outcome Wave06 development separation margin from a same-turnover/same-cost-profile shuffled-label negative control, fixed before any Wave06 result exists and not tuned to either candidate's mechanism.

primary_vs_control_requirement.rationale: The long_short primary must strictly outperform its own long_only control net of costs, or the short leg adds no value and the frozen falsification_condition's 'long-short does not meaningfully outperform long-only' branch is satisfied.

dsr_requirement.metric: deflated_sharpe_ratio (mqk_research.ml.multiple_testing_stats, primary trial, JudgeSpec default cscv_target_block_count=10 baseline -- the accepted module default, and the midpoint of the frozen dsr_pbo_block_count_sensitivity_requirement.block_counts grid below; there is no 'entry_threshold' field on JudgeSpec)
dsr_requirement.rationale: deflated_sharpe_ratio is itself defined (mqk_research.ml.multiple_testing_stats, Bailey & Lopez de Prado 2014) as a probability in [0,1] that the true Sharpe ratio exceeds zero after deflating for the number of trials tested. 0.0 is that probability's lower bound, not its midpoint; 0.5 IS the midpoint (deflated probability >= 50%). This is a NEW, fixed, pre-outcome Wave06 development-stage bar frozen now precisely because it reuses the metric's own defined midpoint -- it is not itself a claim that 0.5 is a canonical production promotion threshold (see not_a_promotion_bypass below).

pbo_requirement.metric: pbo (Probability of Backtest Overfitting, CSCV, mqk_research.ml.multiple_testing_stats, same JudgeSpec default cscv_target_block_count=10 baseline as dsr_requirement)
pbo_requirement.rationale: Reuses PBO's own literature-standard natural interpretation boundary (Bailey, Borwein, Lopez de Prado & Zhu 2017): PBO > 0.5 means the candidate is more likely than not an overfit artifact of the selection process. This is a NEW, fixed, pre-outcome Wave06 development-stage bar that happens to reuse PBO's own defined midpoint -- the literature establishes PBO's own interpretation, not that 0.5 is mandated as production promotion policy; production promotion remains governed solely by the canonical gate named in not_a_promotion_bypass below.

genuine_shuffled_placebo_requirement.rationale: Reuses the evaluator's own already-accepted pass/fail semantics directly -- no new threshold invented.

dsr_pbo_block_count_sensitivity_requirem.definition: mqk_research.ml.dsr_pbo_sensitivity_cli (P9's dsr_pbo_sensitivity scenario) varies ONLY JudgeSpec.cscv_target_block_count via its required --block-counts argument -- it has no entry_threshold to sweep (the Wave06 rank signal policies' own entry_threshold is not a dsr_pbo_sensitivity_cli parameter at all). mqk_backtest::dsr_pbo_sensitivity_scenario likewise requires block_counts, dsr_max_sensitivity_range, and pbo_max_sensitivity_range with no hidden in-crate default.
dsr_pbo_block_count_sensitivity_requirem.block_counts_note: Three distinct even integers >= 4, symmetric around the dsr_requirement/pbo_requirement JudgeSpec default of 10, chosen now (before any Wave06 result exists) and newly authorized by this pre-outcome predeclaration as Wave06 policy -- not inherited as a Rust or CLI default.
dsr_pbo_block_count_sensitivity_requirem.sensitivity_range_rationale: Both DSR and PBO are probabilities in [0,1]; 0.15 is a fixed, round, conservative pre-outcome ceiling on how far either statistic may move across this +/-2-block perturbation around the baseline block count -- chosen before any Wave06 result exists, not tuned to either candidate's mechanism.

canonical_p9_robustness_gauntlet_require.definition: The REAL, complete canonical production robustness protocol (mqk_backtest::robustness_gauntlet), not a Wave06-specific substitute gauntlet. dsr_pbo_block_count_sensitivity_requirement and p7a_p7b_economic_replay_stress_requirement and genuine_shuffled_placebo_requirement above are additional explicit Wave06 evidence checks -- they never substitute for this complete artifact.
canonical_p9_robustness_gauntlet_require.required_scenario_names_source: core-rs/crates/mqk-backtest/src/robustness_gauntlet.rs REQUIRED_ROBUSTNESS_SCENARIO_NAMES, frozen here as the exact current accepted set at predeclaration time
canonical_p9_robustness_gauntlet_require.requirement: artifact.protocol_version == required_protocol_version AND artifact.is_complete() == true AND artifact.all_applicable_passed() == true AND every required_scenario_names entry is present in the artifact's own scenario set
canonical_p9_robustness_gauntlet_require.rationale: A partial artifact containing only a subset of required scenarios (e.g. only dsr_pbo_sensitivity + p7a_p7b_economic_replay_stress + genuine_shuffled_placebo) must never satisfy this gate -- those three are Research-registry-anchored scenarios merged in via RobustnessGauntletOutput::merge_dsr_pbo_sensitivity, not a replacement for the six pure-engine scenarios the canonical protocol also requires.

p7a_p7b_economic_replay_stress_requireme.cli_argument_mapping: stress_execution_slippage_bps -> --stress-execution-slippage-bps (required int); stress_execution_volatility_mult_bps -> --stress-execution-volatility-mult-bps (required int); stress_max_position_notional_usd -> --stress-max-position-notional-usd (optional float, absolute USD notional cap, not a multiplier). No accepted CLI argument named stress_max_target_qty_multiplier or any other multiplier-of-baseline field exists.
p7a_p7b_economic_replay_stress_requireme.stress_max_position_notional_usd_rationa: Baseline WeightToShareSpec (equity_usd=100000.0) declares no max_target_qty/max_position_notional_usd cap at all (an uncapped baseline). The PRIMARY development candidate is the long_short direction (primary_candidate_direction_control_relationship.primary above), whose rank_side_count=5 equal-weight LONG-SHORT sizing spreads max_gross_exposure=1.0 across both the long and short legs, producing a natural per-position notional of max_gross_exposure(1.0) / (2*rank_side_count(5)) * equity_usd(100000) = $10,000 at baseline -- not the long-only per-position notional of max_gross_exposure(1.0) / rank_side_count(5) * equity_usd(100000) = $20,000, which is long_only's CONTROL-direction sizing, not the primary's. $5,000 is a fixed, pre-outcome absolute USD cap equal to half the primary long_short direction's own natural per-position notional -- strictly tighter than the uncapped baseline (mqk_research.ml.p7a_p7b_economic_replay_stress_cli._classify_cap_transition classifies baseline=None/stress=finite as 'tighter', and this value is additionally genuinely binding, not a vacuous cap chosen only to pass the CLI's own genuineness check) and chosen this way rather than as an absolute share quantity because this is a mixed-price 88-symbol universe where a single share-count cap would not apply uniformly across symbols.
p7a_p7b_economic_replay_stress_requireme.requirement: evaluator's own reported passed == true under the frozen stress knobs above
p7a_p7b_economic_replay_stress_requireme.rationale: Reuses the evaluator's own already-accepted pass/fail semantics (max_drawdown >= -max_drawdown_ceiling) and its own _validate_genuine_p7a_p7b_adversity check. Stress knobs are fixed genuinely-adverse values chosen before any result exists; max_drawdown_ceiling=0.40 is a round, conservative, pre-registered risk bound.

advancement_policy.fail_closed_not_evaluable: any required metric reporting a not_evaluable (or equivalent) status at any required evaluation point is treated as REJECTED_NOT_ADVANCED -- never skipped, never defaulted to pass.

gross_wealth_insolvency_terminal_classif.definition: A POLICY-TERMINAL ECONOMIC FAILURE, distinct from an OPERATIONAL/PROVIDER/IO/UNKNOWN failure. Only an attempt whose recorded failure_reason is EXACTLY one of the recognized strings below is a policy-terminal economic failure; every other failed or crashed attempt (a generic RuntimeError, a provider/network error, or any failed attempt with no recognized policy-terminal cause) leaves the candidate incomplete/BLOCKED and never authorizes closeout or the next candidate.
recognized_failure_reason_strings: RuntimeError: Fail-closed: discrete gross wealth ledger equity is <= 0 -- cannot compute a further return fraction
gross_wealth_insolvency_terminal_classif.recognized_failure_reason_source: mqk_research.ml.economic_walkforward's discrete-return fail-closed gross-wealth-ledger check, and economic_registry_integration.run_registered_economic_walkforward_eval's own f'{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}' failure_reason formatting -- both already-accepted, unmodified production code. Byte-for-byte matches the precedent already realized in docs/research/DISCOVERY_01_LOW_VOLATILITY_ANOMALY_RESULT.md Section 4/5.
gross_wealth_insolvency_terminal_classif.on_match: REJECTED_NOT_ADVANCED for the absolute_economic_requirement gate; every downstream gate that a genuinely insolvent real attempt could never have produced evidence for is recorded honestly as NOT_RUN_AFTER_DETERMINISTIC_REJECTION, never fabricated as passed or not_evaluable.
gross_wealth_insolvency_terminal_classif.on_no_match: the candidate closeout is refused (returns incomplete/BLOCKED, not a terminal verdict) -- an unrecognized failure never authorizes REJECTED_NOT_ADVANCED or the next candidate.

advancement_policy.early_rejection_semantics: REJECTED_NOT_ADVANCED may be assigned as soon as any single required gate above fails or is not_evaluable, without evaluating every remaining gate (short-circuit, matching the frozen falsification_condition's 'and/or' phrasing) -- but the closeout record must name every gate actually evaluated and its outcome (or NOT_RUN_AFTER_DETERMINISTIC_REJECTION for a gate a terminal rejection genuinely made impossible to run), never only the first failure and never a fabricated outcome for an unrun gate.

verdict_definitions.REJECTED_NOT_ADVANCED: At least one required gate (absolute economic solvency, benchmark-relative, matched-placebo, primary-vs-control, DSR, PBO, genuine shuffled placebo, dsr_pbo_block_count_sensitivity, canonical P9 robustness gauntlet, P7A/P7B stress) fails or is not_evaluable. benchmark-relative fails exactly when benchmark_excess <= 0.0.
verdict_definitions.INCONCLUSIVE: Every required gate is evaluable and none fails outright (per REJECTED_NOT_ADVANCED's own partition above), and the benchmark-relative excess falls in the dead-zone band 0.0 < benchmark_excess < 0.05 -- too close to the minimum bar to distinguish from measurement noise at this sample size -- while every other gate passes with margin.
verdict_definitions.DEVELOPMENT_PROMISING_REQUIRES_FRESH_POI: Every required gate passes strictly, including the benchmark-relative excess reaching or exceeding the INCONCLUSIVE dead-zone's upper edge (benchmark_excess >= 0.05). This is the maximum possible verdict for this non-point-in-time development study; it does NOT authorize PROMOTION_READY or PROVEN_ALPHA and does NOT itself authorize Paper/Live -- it requires a NEW, separately-predeclared, fresh point-in-time-clean confirmation mission before any promotion verification may begin.

benchmark_relative_verdict_partition.definition: Non-overlapping, gap-free partition of benchmark_excess = net_sharpe(primary) - net_sharpe(benchmark) used by verdict_definitions above.

closeout_verdict_authority.policy: The verdict written into CANDIDATE_CLOSEOUT_STATUS.json is COMPUTED by classify_verdict() from a caller-supplied evidence dict binding each gate above to real measured values/artifact identity -- no public writer accepts a caller-authored verdict string as authority-bearing. campaign_order_guard.load_verified_closeout() independently recomputes the verdict from the closeout's own stored evidence and refuses (returns None) on any mismatch, on any evidence-hash mismatch, or on evidence that fails classify_verdict()'s own internal validation -- a hand-edited verdict or hand-edited evidence field is never trusted over this recomputation.

advancement_policy.not_a_promotion_bypass: This development advancement policy governs ONLY whether this non-point-in-time development study continues investing research effort in a mechanism. It never weakens, substitutes for, or bypasses the canonical production promotion gate (mqk_research.ml.real_research_promotion_e2e_cli and mqk-promotion's Rust verifier), which remains the sole authority for PROMOTION_READY under its own, separately-frozen, point-in-time-clean evidence requirements.

stopping_rule.text: Execute candidates strictly in campaign_order, gated by campaign_order_guard. If a candidate's registry-verified closeout classifies it REJECTED_NOT_ADVANCED or INCONCLUSIVE per the frozen advancement_policy, do NOT tune it -- proceed to the next predeclared candidate. If a candidate's registry-verified closeout classifies it DEVELOPMENT_PROMISING_REQUIRES_FRESH_POINT_IN_TIME_CONFIRMATION, STOP the remaining candidate campaign; this non-point-in-time development study never itself proceeds to promotion verification -- a positive result requires a NEW, separately-predeclared, fresh point-in-time-clean confirmation mission before any promotion verification may begin. Do not substitute a fourth candidate. Do not invent a new candidate after seeing any result.

candidate_selection_constraints: materially different from every previously tested return-trend/short-horizon-return/gap/volatility mechanism in tested_hypothesis_exclusion_matrix
not a threshold, K, rank-band, turnover, rebalance-interval, cost-assumption, lookback, or universe tweak of any previously tested mechanism
executable using current causal next-bar economic_walk_forward_v1 machinery
economically interpretable and supported by a primary peer-reviewed reference
no reliance on inaccessible proprietary data (no fundamentals, no earnings calendar, no shares-outstanding)
no requirement for new multi-asset infrastructure
no requirement to weaken production/backtest conservatism
universe_reuse_rationale: Both candidates reuse the SAME already-committed, already-exercised-twice (SHORT-WAVE-03, DISCOVERY-01) 88-symbol current-registry-snapshot universe (universe_id=f25e8ec952c1429af7ac3bb58169408e), not a fresh point-in-time universe. LIQ-01's mechanism (illiquidity risk premium) specifically requires genuine cross-sectional variation in liquidity, which a fixed liquid-ETF-only universe would suppress by construction -- the broader mixed equity+ETF snapshot is the scientifically appropriate choice for that mechanism, and reusing the identical universe for VOL-01 keeps the only varying factor between this campaign's two candidates the feature itself. This is not a fresh PIT universe manufactured to enlarge the campaign.

holdout_reservation.policy: Each candidate reserves its own final holdout window (2024-11-01..2025-05-01, WF_HOLDOUT_MONTHS=6) via mqk_research.ml.holdout_ledger.reserve_holdout. holdout_id is content-bound to that candidate's own feature/bars dataset identity (compute_holdout_id), so LIQ-01, VOL-01, and DISCOVERY-01's own reserved holdout are three structurally distinct ledger entries even though the calendar window is identical for all three. No candidate in this campaign may call consume_holdout.

prohibited_after_this_commit: adding a third or fourth candidate to campaign_order without a new, separately-reviewed predeclaration
reordering campaign_order after seeing any candidate's result
retuning LIQ-01 or VOL-01 (window/threshold/universe/horizon) after seeing its own result
relabeling a previously tested mechanism (see tested_hypothesis_exclusion_matrix) as a new candidate
claiming PROVEN_ALPHA or PROMOTION_READY for either candidate
consuming the reserved final holdout for either candidate
starting Paper, arming Paper, starting the daemon, or submitting any broker order from this campaign's Lane-A work
